name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Vermosa Leg
short_description: A half-marathon leg of the National MILO Marathon 2026 taking place October 11, 2026 in Vermosa, Cavite, Philippines.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Vermosa Leg is a half-marathon event scheduled for October 11, 2026, held in Vermosa, spanning Imus and Dasmariñas, Cavite, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc. under the long-running MILO Marathon banner, it offers multiple distance options including 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and the primary 21.1km half-marathon. Registration status has not yet been confirmed as open.
pros: Multiple distance options (1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, 21.1km) suit different runner levels
Organized by RUNRIO Inc., part of the established MILO Marathon series
Set in Vermosa, a defined venue across Imus/Dasmariñas, Cavite
cons: Registration status is not yet confirmed as open, so details on signing up are unavailable

research_highlights: The Vermosa leg is held at Daang Hari Road corner Vermosa Blvd., Imus, Cavite, inside the Ayala Land Vermosa mixed-use development.
Race distances offered at this leg have included 21K Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, 3K and 1K Active Kids categories.
Runners qualifying at this leg who hit their age-group qualifying time can advance to the National MILO Marathon Finals.
The 2026 edition is part of the marathon's 50th-anniversary calendar, with the National Finals to be held in Clark City, Pampanga on December 6, 2026.
The event is organized by RUNRIO, INC., which requires a signed 'Fit-To-Run' medical certificate for the 21K/42K categories and enforces strict start-time and singlet/bib rules.
research_watchouts: At least one runner who completed the 21K described the Vermosa route as having 'CRAZY uphill sections,' suggesting the course is hillier than a flat urban route.
Participants are disqualified if they do not start within 10 minutes of their category's flag-off time, so arriving late to the corral can cost you your result.
Entry fees are non-refundable and online registration platforms add processing, web and delivery fees on top of the published race fee.

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Vermosa Leg?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled to take place on October 11, 2026. It is held at Vermosa, a venue located across Imus and Dasmariñas in Cavite, Philippines, as part of the broader National MILO Marathon 2026 series of events.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers five distance categories: 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half-marathon is the primary distance for this leg, giving participants a range of options from short fun runs to a full half-marathon challenge.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Vermosa Leg is organized by RUNRIO Inc., which manages events under the long-standing MILO Marathon banner. This organizer is responsible for coordinating the race across its various legs, including the Vermosa location in Cavite.
